dsh-jenkins-cli 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。管理多台 Jenkins 服务器，支持从设置页、模型工具或工作区级「执行 Jenkins Job」入口触发构建，宿主 + 浏览器双端、界面中英双语。

posts.en:
dsh-jenkins-cli is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Manages multiple Jenkins servers and triggers jobs from a Settings page, model tools, or a per-workspace "Run Jenkins Job" entry, with a bilingual host + browser UI.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-5d97b2c44b67189ea43d.html
